title: Verses to Restore the Lost Things

blocks.x: To restore a lost animal, it is advised to recite Surah Yasin in a twounit prayer and then this supplicatory prayer may be said:
To restore a fugitive servant, it is advised to recite this holy verse:
او كظلمات فى بحر لجىّ،يغشاه موج من فوقه موج تا و من لم يجعل اللّه له نور فما له من نور
